itens.titulo: Tesla Surges 5% as 486,532 Deliveries Top Company Consensus; Rivian Slides 3%
itens.descricao: Tesla Surges 5% as 486,532 Deliveries Top Company Consensus; Rivian Slides 3% Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       Tesla surged 5% after delivering 486,532 vehicles, beating its own internal consensus of 461,974, while Rivian dropped 3% despite an in-line quarter.
-       Tesla's beat still trailed last year's 497,099 deliveries, keeping its growth trajectory in question ahead of full Q3 financial results later this month.
(Sponsor) Two electric vehicle makers released third-quarter 2026 delivery reports, and the market is sending Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) and Rivian Automotive (NASDAQ:RIVN) in opposite directions.
Tesla stock is up 5% to $372.64 after the company exceeded a delivery consensus it compiled and published itself.
Meanwhile, Rivian stock is slipping 3% to $14.28, even though the company called its quarter in line with management's outlook.
For sector context, the Global X Autonomous & Electric Vehicles ETF (NASDAQ:DRIV) is up 2% to $33.73, a much smaller advance than the one in Tesla stock.
Meanwhile, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) is also up less than 1.1% to $772.43, a solid but comparatively modest gain for the broad market.
Tesla Tops Its Own Delivery Consensus Tesla reported delivering 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, the headline number behind the rally.

itens.titulo: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Street Estimate, Gene Munster Says ‘EV Winter’ Is Thawing — Sees 15% Growth In Full Year 2027
itens.descricao: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Street Estimate, Gene Munster Says ‘EV Winter’ Is Thawing — Sees 15% Growth In Full Year 2027 Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Street Estimate, Gene Munster Says ‘EV Winter’ Is Thawing — Sees 15% Growth In Full Year 2027 -       Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3, beating its company-compiled consensus of 461,974 units.
-       Tesla produced 464,391 vehicles, including 457,387 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles.
-       Tesla's full Q3 financial results are due October 21.
Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter (Q3), with Model 3 and Model Y comprising 478,237 units.
Tesla also produced 464,391 vehicles, including 457,387 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles.
The result comfortably topped Tesla's company-compiled analyst consensus of 461,974 deliveries.
How Q3 Compares With Previous Quarters Deliveries increased about 1.3% sequentially, while production rose nearly 3%.
However, Q3 deliveries were about 2% lower than last year, when Tesla recorded its highest quarterly deliveries.

itens.titulo: Tesla Stock Jumps 6% on Delivery Beat: Will Earnings Back It Up?
itens.descricao: Tesla Stock Jumps 6% on Delivery Beat: Will Earnings Back It Up? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles between July and September, beating the average forecast from 24 analysts by about 24,600.
Tesla stock rose 5.5% to $373.55 by mid-morning Friday, according to Yahoo Finance.
Tesla built 464,391 vehicles, so about 22,000 of the cars it handed to buyers were made in earlier quarters.
What Drove Tesla's Delivery Beat Model 3 and Model Y, Tesla's mass-market sedan and SUV, did nearly all the work.
They reached 478,237 deliveries, against 450,712 in Tesla's own survey of analyst forecasts.
Deliveries came to 8,295, below the 11,285 expected and roughly half the 15,933 a year earlier.
Total deliveries slipped about 2% from more than 497,000 a year ago.
That quarter was inflated by buyers rushing to claim a $7,500 US electric vehicle tax credit before it expired on Sept.

itens.titulo: Amazon Is Both Landlord And Shareholder In Anthropic’s Giant Cloud Bet
itens.descricao: Amazon Is Both Landlord And Shareholder In Anthropic’s Giant Cloud Bet Yahoo Finance
trechos: Anthropic's draft IPO prospectus, as reported by Reuters, shows about $110 billion owed to Amazon Web Services (AWS) over roughly the next decade.
A Lease You Can't Walk Away From Anthropic plans $518 billion of cloud, computing and infrastructure obligations in coming years.
Amazon's share traces back to a pledge of more than $100 billion over 10 years.
Spread evenly, the AWS portion runs above $10 billion a year.
Anthropic reportedly spent $7.33 billion on all of its suppliers combined in 2025, so this only looks comfortable if revenue keeps scaling.
The draft gives us a reason to stay alert, since almost a quarter of 2025 revenue came from two customers.
It has put $18 billion into Anthropic, split between convertible notes and nonvoting preferred stock, with up to $15 billion more available.
Those holdings are now carried at about $190 billion, up from about $61 billion at the end of 2025.

itens.titulo: ANP aprova configuração de 501 novos blocos na Margem Equatorial
itens.descricao: ANP aprova configuração de 501 novos blocos na Margem Equatorial Agência eixos
trechos: A Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou, na reunião desta sexta-feira (2/10) a configuração de 501 novos blocos exploratórios na Margem Equatorial, localizados em lâmina d’água superior a 3 mil metros.

“A proposta não produz impacto sobre contratos vigentes, uma vez que os novos setores e blocos objeto da atualização correspondem a áreas ainda não contratadas”, explicou a relatora, diretora Symone Araújo.
A aprovação também não implicará na inclusão automática dos 501 blocos nos editais de oferta permanente.
“Forçoso destacar que este hoje é o principal desafio para a inclusão de novos blocos na Margem Equatorial brasileira”, disse Symone Araújo.
“O desafio de obter uma manifestação conjunta que complemente o compliance socioambiental para inclusão de novos blocos na oferta permanente”, completou.

Após o reconhecimento do aumento desse limite, o Conselho Nacional de Política Energética (CNPE) aprovou a resolução 10/2025, que definiu as regras para exploração na Extensão da Plataforma Continental Brasileira, além das 200 milhas marítimas da costa.

“O tema ganha muita relevância num cenário em que o país depende de novas fronteiras exploratórias para manter seus níveis de produção e oferta nas próximas décadas, ou seja, é um tema de segurança energética”, destacou Symone Araújo.

itens.titulo: Tempo real: Ibovespa cai e destoa de exterior positivo com payroll; dólar volta a ganhar força
itens.descricao: Tempo real: Ibovespa cai e destoa de exterior positivo com payroll; dólar volta a ganhar força Money Times
itens.texto:
A XP Investimentos reiterou a recomendação de compra para o XP Crédito Agrícola Fiagro (XPCA11), destacando o desconto de aproximadamente 24% em relação ao valor patrimonial e a projeção de 16,4% de retorno em dividendos nos próximos 12 meses.
No relatório assinado por Marx Gonçalves e Eduardo Bacelar, a corretora sustenta a avaliação positiva em três fatores: preço atrativo, perspectiva de rendimentos e diversificação setorial. A exposição à AgroGalaxy, que permanece inadimplente, é o principal ponto de atenção.
